prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a person holding a modern smartphone in their right hand, displaying a music player app on the screen. The phone’s display shows an abstract, colorful album cover with swirling neon hues of green, pink, and yellow, and the song title “Detected Chimp” by Air Bud, CL Smoov & Abdul G. The music player interface is sleek and minimal, with play, pause, and skip controls clearly visible. The person’s hand is in sharp focus, with natural skin tones and subtle details in the fingers and nails. The individual is wearing a soft pink shirt, visible at the edge of the frame, and a gold chain necklace, suggesting a casual yet stylish appearance. The background is softly blurred, featuring warm, diffused sunlight streaming through sheer curtains, casting a gentle golden glow and creating a cozy, inviting atmosphere. The overall color palette is warm and harmonious, with soft yellows, pinks, and natural skin tones. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to emphasize the phone and hand, while the background remains unobtrusive. The lighting is natural and ambient, enhancing the relaxed, everyday mood of the scene. The camera angle is slightly below eye level, adding a sense of intimacy and immediacy to the image.
